name: OpenCode Usage
author: markbus-ai
description: OpenCode token usage and models in a native Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: token usage by day and by model read from your local OpenCode database.

schema.label: Safety refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Fallback poll. Normal refreshes are event-driven: the widget watches the OpenCode database and scans only after it changes.

schema.label: Watch database for changes
schema.description: Use inotify on the OpenCode data directory so idle time costs nothing. Disable to fall back to the safety interval only.

schema.label: Minimum seconds between background scans
schema.description: While OpenCode is streaming it writes constantly; this coalesces those writes into one quick scan.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.

schema.label: OpenCode database path
schema.description: Optional override for the OpenCode SQLite database. Defaults to $OPENCODE_DB or $XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode/opencode.db.
